title: 平行定規付き傾斜製図台
titleEn: Tilting drafting table with parallel rule
description: 設計教室・交流施設の制作室に置く傾斜製図台。30度に固定した無地の板面、裏補強、前の鉛筆受け、平行定規と小さな滑車・実ケーブル、二本の支柱とT字脚、回転支点・傾斜支持材・固定ノブを造形。紙・図面・筆記具・椅子は含まず、板と定規は一台に含まれます。高さ・傾斜・定規の可動機能と精度検証はありません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.231 × 1.294 × 0.858 m、8,592三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A tilting drafting table for design classrooms and community studios. It has a blank board fixed at thirty degrees, rear stiffeners, front pencil ledge, parallel rule with small pulleys and real cable geometry, twin pedestals/T feet, tilt pivots, supporting struts and fixed knobs. Paper, drawings, writing tools and chair are absent; board and ruler belong to one table assembly. Height, tilt and rule movement and accuracy validation are not provided. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.231 × 1.294 × 0.858 m; 8,592 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
